dedupe_keys.name: risicokaart netherlands risk map of hazardous substance sites and other disaster types

description: The Dutch public risk map. The home page says Risicokaart gives information on situations such as floods, wildfires and accidents with hazardous substances so that anyone can prepare, and that the detailed information helps professionals keep the living environment safe; its risk situations include earthquakes, nuclear accidents, aviation accidents, wildfires, accidents with hazardous substances, accidents on water, floods and public disorder. The data page says the map makes data on risk situations freely available to government bodies for spatial planning, environmental permitting, enforcement and disaster preparedness; that hazardous substance data sit in the Register of external safety risks managed by the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, fed by municipalities, provinces and the state; and that municipalities own the data for other disaster types. It is free to use. Coverage is the Netherlands. Caveats: the download formats and licence are not stated on the pages read. For simulation it locates hazardous-substance establishments and their risk contours for exposure and consequence analysis. A related catalogue record is eSPIRS Seveso plants.
